name: security-audit
description: Audit a web project for the attack chains that actually get apps hacked (unguarded endpoints, stored XSS reaching a staff browser, privilege escalation through user/role admin, forgeable sessions, AI/LLM tool abuse, sandbox and dependency blast radius) with parallel read-only agents, verify the findings, read production facts read-only, and fix them in priority order. Includes a server-function guard scanner for TanStack Start.
